wholeProduct.summary: TradeScout remains a multi-app local operating system. This slice refines one resumable Scout-to-Community work loop without claiming whole-product completion.

deliverables.outcome: The signed-in OS shell uses the bottom taskbar for primary navigation and compact top-right system controls without universal dashboard rails.

A person can recognize and resume one existing Scout task, see its latest meaningful state and next action beside the composer, and open a feed-first Community surface without repeating intent or crossing contact and county gates.
deliverables.entry: Open an authenticated saved Scout thread for a local flooring-project request, or open the local Community feed.
deliverables.ending: Resume the existing Scout thread, take its existing next action, move to Community, and return with the same thread, county, and entered work intact.
journeySteps: Open Scout and see existing thread identity, latest meaningful state, one dominant existing action, and the single composer together in the first viewport.
Save the thread, start a new thread, then reopen the saved thread and recover the same messages, action state, and composer.
Open Community and reach create, compact view controls, and real feed content before a tall generic-action wall.
Reach all five existing Community action modes through compact progressive disclosure.
Return to Scout without losing the existing thread or county context.
constraints: Derive task identity, latest state, and next action only from existing Scout thread, message, and controller state; add no persistence, route, API, or data owner.
Keep full Scout history reachable and preserve exactly one fixed composer after a thread starts.
Keep every existing Community action route and preserve global browse-only, county, Trust/CVS, and Intent to Decision Card to Contact behavior.
Reuse canonical client/src and server/tests owners; do not edit mirrored exports/workspaces trees or add parallel Scout, Community, shell, taskbar, or feed components.
Keep primary navigation in the bottom taskbar, tools at the top right, accessible targets, and zero page-level horizontal overflow.
Do not copy Windows branding or literal window chrome, and do not describe this slice as whole-product completion.
proofRequired: Focused contract tests for task-workspace framing, saved-thread resume behavior, non-wrapping Community controls, all five Community routes, and global browse-only gates.
Typecheck and production build against the exact implementation commit.
Authenticated browser proof at 1440x1000 and 390x844 using the same saved flooring-project state, including Scout resume and feed-first geometry.
Exact minimum-release gate and post-deploy build-identity proof before any release completion claim.

executionTarget.rationale: The canonical TradeScout application already owns the authenticated shell, Scout controller and threads, Community routes, platform gates, tests, and release contract needed for this repair.
